name: Notification Item
description: A sanitized ecosystem inbox row with severity, source application, read state, deep link, and delivery-state controls.
usage:
<NotificationItem
  severity="warning"
  appLabel="Yang Operations"
  timestamp="2 hours ago"
  title="photos-api restarted unexpectedly"
  href="https://yang.example/incidents/photos-api"
  onMute={() => undefined}
  onArchive={() => undefined}
/>

anatomy.description: Small colored marker matched to the severity variant.
Decorative status icon beside the content; hidden from assistive technology.
Deep link to the source application event; unread items are bold and append a screen-reader-only unread marker.
Source application label and caller-supplied timestamp.
Optional IconButtons that change delivery state only, never the source event.

dos: Pass sanitized title and appLabel from the ecosystem payload; the row renders what it is given.
Wire mute and archive to delivery-state endpoints only.
donts: Don't mutate the source event from onMute or onArchive.
Don't use NotificationItem for feedback local to the current task; use Alert or Toast.

examples.title: Unread with controls
examples.description: Unread items are emphasized and announced; mute and archive only touch delivery state, never the source event.

examples.title: Read
examples.description: Read items drop the emphasis and the unread announcement.

guidance.useWhen: An inbox lists sanitized pointers to application events.
guidance.avoidWhen: The feedback is local to the current task; use Alert or Toast instead.
guidance.behavior: Mute and archive touch delivery state only; the deep link never mutates the source.
guidance.responsive: Text wraps and controls stay reachable at mobile widths.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the title link and to the mute and archive buttons.
Follows the title link to the source application.
Activates the mute or archive button.

notes: Unread items are bold and append a screen-reader-only ", unread" marker to the title link.
The severity dot and icon are aria-hidden; severity must also be clear from the title or surrounding context.
Mute and archive are IconButtons with explicit accessible labels.

props.description: Label of the source application, supplied sanitized by the caller.
props.name: appLabel

props.description: URL of the source application deep link.
props.name: href

props.description: Renders an archive control and calls this when pressed. Never mutates the source event.
props.name: onArchive

props.description: Renders a mute control and calls this when pressed. Never mutates the source event.
props.name: onMute

props.description: Marks the item as read; unread items are emphasized and announce an unread marker.
props.name: read

props.description: Severity drives the indicator and icon.
props.name: severity

props.description: Human-readable timestamp supplied by the caller.
props.name: timestamp

props.description: Notification title, supplied sanitized by the caller.
props.name: title
